_meta.note: First-pass translations, not native-speaker-reviewed. English (en) and Indonesian (id) carry higher confidence given this codebase's existing Bali/Asia-Makassar context; Thai (th), Vietnamese (vi), and Tagalog (tl) are best-effort drafts and MUST be QA'd by a native/fluent speaker before shipping to any customer-facing surface. Do not treat th/vi/tl strings as production-verified.
_meta.g5dNote: SCP-G5-D-01 added the `acknowledgement` and `customer` sections for the Freshline customer surface. English is authored; Indonesian carries the same DRAFT_TRANSLATION status as the rest of this file and must be reviewed by a fluent speaker before any production customer traffic. Thai, Vietnamese and Tagalog are deliberately absent from the new sections: the governed Bali configuration supports en and id only, and inventing unreviewed translations for unsupported locales would be worse than their absence.
_meta.g5eNote: SCP-G5-E-01 added the `partner` section for the Freshline Partner portal. English is authored; Indonesian carries the same DRAFT_TRANSLATION status as the rest of this file and must be reviewed by a fluent speaker before any production partner traffic (R24). Thai, Vietnamese and Tagalog are deliberately absent: the governed Bali configuration supports en and id only.

invalid_phone_number.en: Please enter a valid phone number.
invalid_phone_number.th: กรุณากรอกหมายเลขโทรศัพท์ที่ถูกต้อง
invalid_phone_number.vi: Vui lòng nhập số điện thoại hợp lệ.
invalid_phone_number.tl: Mangyaring maglagay ng wastong numero ng telepono.

invalid_email.en: Please enter a valid email address.
invalid_email.th: กรุณากรอกอีเมลที่ถูกต้อง
invalid_email.vi: Vui lòng nhập địa chỉ email hợp lệ.
invalid_email.tl: Mangyaring maglagay ng wastong email address.

closing_ceiling_exceeded.en: This booking would end after closing time. Please choose an earlier start time.
closing_ceiling_exceeded.id: Pemesanan ini akan berakhir setelah jam tutup. Silakan pilih waktu mulai yang lebih awal.
closing_ceiling_exceeded.th: การจองนี้จะสิ้นสุดหลังเวลาปิดทำการ กรุณาเลือกเวลาเริ่มต้นที่เร็วขึ้น
closing_ceiling_exceeded.vi: Lịch đặt này sẽ kết thúc sau giờ đóng cửa. Vui lòng chọn giờ bắt đầu sớm hơn.
closing_ceiling_exceeded.tl: Ang booking na ito ay matatapos pagkalipas ng oras ng pagsara. Mangyaring pumili ng mas maagang oras ng simula.

before_opening.en: This time is before we open. Please choose a later start time.
before_opening.id: Waktu ini sebelum kami buka. Silakan pilih waktu mulai yang lebih siang.
before_opening.th: เวลานี้ก่อนเวลาเปิดทำการของเรา กรุณาเลือกเวลาเริ่มต้นที่ช้าลง
before_opening.vi: Thời gian này trước giờ mở cửa của chúng tôi. Vui lòng chọn giờ bắt đầu muộn hơn.
before_opening.tl: Ang oras na ito ay bago pa kami magbukas. Mangyaring pumili ng mas huling oras ng simula.

service_unavailable.id: Layanan ini saat ini tidak tersedia.
service_unavailable.th: บริการนี้ไม่พร้อมให้บริการในขณะนี้
service_unavailable.vi: Dịch vụ này hiện không khả dụng.
service_unavailable.tl: Kasalukuyang hindi available ang serbisyong ito.

billing_code_invalid.en: We couldn't recognize that booking code. Please check and try again.
billing_code_invalid.id: Kami tidak dapat mengenali kode pemesanan tersebut. Silakan periksa kembali.
billing_code_invalid.th: เราไม่สามารถจดจำรหัสการจองนั้นได้ กรุณาตรวจสอบอีกครั้ง
billing_code_invalid.vi: Chúng tôi không nhận ra mã đặt lịch đó. Vui lòng kiểm tra lại.
billing_code_invalid.tl: Hindi namin makilala ang booking code na iyan. Mangyaring suriin at subukan muli.

session_expired.en: Your session has expired. Please start again.
session_expired.id: Sesi Anda telah berakhir. Silakan mulai lagi.
session_expired.th: เซสชันของคุณหมดอายุแล้ว กรุณาเริ่มต้นใหม่
session_expired.vi: Phiên của bạn đã hết hạn. Vui lòng bắt đầu lại.
session_expired.tl: Nag-expire na ang iyong session. Mangyaring magsimula muli.

needs_clarification.en: We couldn't confirm your reply. A team member will follow up shortly.
needs_clarification.id: Kami tidak dapat mengonfirmasi balasan Anda. Tim kami akan segera menghubungi Anda.
needs_clarification.th: เราไม่สามารถยืนยันคำตอบของคุณได้ ทีมงานจะติดต่อกลับในไม่ช้า
needs_clarification.vi: Chúng tôi không thể xác nhận phản hồi của bạn. Đội ngũ hỗ trợ sẽ liên hệ sớm.
needs_clarification.tl: Hindi namin makumpirma ang iyong sagot. Makikipag-ugnayan sa iyo ang aming team sa lalong madaling panahon.

body.en: Thank you — your request is now with the {brand} team. We're checking availability and will come back to you shortly.
body.id: Terima kasih — permintaan Anda kini ada di tim {brand}. Kami sedang memeriksa ketersediaan dan akan segera menghubungi Anda.

next_step.en: Keep this reference. Nothing is scheduled yet — we'll message you on WhatsApp as soon as we have a time and a specialist for you.
next_step.id: Simpan nomor referensi ini. Belum ada jadwal yang ditetapkan — kami akan mengirim pesan WhatsApp begitu kami memiliki waktu dan spesialis untuk Anda.

next_step_replay.en: We already have this request — this is the same reference, not a second request. Nothing has changed on your side.
next_step_replay.id: Kami sudah memiliki permintaan ini — ini referensi yang sama, bukan permintaan kedua. Tidak ada yang berubah dari sisi Anda.

notice_state.en: Sending this is a request, not a reservation. Our team reviews every one.
notice_state.id: Mengirim ini adalah permintaan, bukan reservasi. Tim kami meninjau setiap permintaan.

notice_payment.en: No payment is taken online. You settle directly with your specialist.
notice_payment.id: Tidak ada pembayaran online. Anda membayar langsung kepada spesialis Anda.

notice_whatsapp.en: We coordinate over WhatsApp. It is how we reach you — it is not where your request lives.
notice_whatsapp.id: Kami berkoordinasi melalui WhatsApp. Itu cara kami menghubungi Anda — bukan tempat permintaan Anda disimpan.

error_generic.en: Something went wrong on our side. Your details are still here — please try again.
error_generic.id: Terjadi kesalahan di pihak kami. Detail Anda masih tersimpan — silakan coba lagi.

hint_date_format.id: Format tanggal mengikuti pengaturan peramban Anda (bb/hh/tttt).

stage_profile_not_submitted.en: Start by telling us about yourself.
stage_profile_not_submitted.id: Mulailah dengan menceritakan tentang diri Anda.

stage_profile_submitted.en: Profile saved. Submit it for review when you are ready.
stage_profile_submitted.id: Profil tersimpan. Kirim untuk ditinjau jika Anda sudah siap.

stage_owner_review.en: With the Freshline team for review. Nothing is active yet.
stage_owner_review.id: Sedang ditinjau tim Freshline. Belum ada yang aktif.

stage_awaiting_schedule.en: Your card is approved. Your week still needs the team's confirmation.
stage_awaiting_schedule.id: Kartu Anda disetujui. Minggu Anda masih menunggu konfirmasi tim.

stage_approved_supply.en: Your card and this week are both confirmed.
stage_approved_supply.id: Kartu Anda dan minggu ini keduanya sudah dikonfirmasi.

notice_not_approved.en: Saving a profile is not approval. The Freshline team reviews every partner.
notice_not_approved.id: Menyimpan profil bukan berarti disetujui. Tim Freshline meninjau setiap mitra.

notice_not_confirmed.en: Sending your week is not confirmation. The team confirms schedules separately.
notice_not_confirmed.id: Mengirim minggu Anda bukan konfirmasi. Tim mengonfirmasi jadwal secara terpisah.

notice_no_assignment.en: Setting your availability never books a customer for you. Assignment is a separate step the team owns.
notice_no_assignment.id: Mengatur ketersediaan tidak pernah memesan pelanggan untuk Anda. Penugasan adalah langkah terpisah milik tim.

notice_id_assigned.en: Your Partner ID is issued by the Freshline team when your card is approved.
notice_id_assigned.id: ID Mitra Anda diterbitkan oleh tim Freshline saat kartu Anda disetujui.

error_generic.en: Something went wrong on our side. Your details are still here — please try again.
error_generic.id: Terjadi kesalahan di pihak kami. Detail Anda masih tersimpan — silakan coba lagi.

offer_caveat.en: A recommendation, not an authorised price for you.
offer_caveat.fr: Une recommandation, et non un prix qui vous est accordé.

av_not_eligible.fr: disponible, mais non éligible pour vous

reason_ineligible.en: This time is available but you are not eligible for it, so it cannot be reserved.
reason_ineligible.fr: Cet horaire est disponible mais vous n'y êtes pas éligible : il ne peut donc pas être réservé.

result_body.en: This is a fixture result. Nothing has been reserved, nothing has been charged, and no canonical record exists.
result_body.fr: Ceci est un résultat fictif. Rien n'a été réservé, rien n'a été facturé, et aucun enregistrement canonique n'existe.

Your style, your space, your Freshline..id: Gaya Anda, ruang Anda, Freshline Anda.
